recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a woman with a blonde 1960s bob hairstyle, featuring heavy eyeliner and a soft-focus outdoor background. The composition is dominated by bold, overlapping red typography at the top and a structured list of text on the left, framed by a thin black line.
coreVisualRelationships: The large red display text overlaps the subject's hair, creating depth.
The thin black oval frame contains the primary artist name, separating it from the expressive exclamation above.
The left-aligned tracklist balances the right-leaning gaze of the subject.
The pink neck scarf echoes the warmth of the red typography.
coreInvariants: Blonde hair with high-volume crown and side-swept bangs
Vibrant red as the primary typographic color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and scaled to fill the lower two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold red serif text across the top third of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the expressive red exclamation, move down to the framed name, then follow the subject's gaze toward the right edge before settling on the tracklist on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the area to the left of the face provide breathing room for text elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and blonde hair provide the central neutral-warm base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red (approx. Hex #E63946) for primary typography against the light hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright pink for the neck scarf and soft blue/green in the background bokeh.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red text and pink scarf contrasts with the desaturated, high-key lighting of the skin and hair.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to red, pink, white, and natural tones

letterConstructionRules: Display text features vertical stress and sharp, bracketed serifs.
The top exclamation uses an arched baseline with varying letter sizes.
The main name is tightly tracked and enclosed in a thin-stroke pill shape.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' characters in the top line decrease in size to create a receding perspective effect.
Exclamation points are elongated and slanted.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast bold serif for the title paired with a functional, heavy sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Overlapping colored circles at the bottom center

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and bold verticality of the display text.
Appropriate for the secondary sans-serif list text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus outdoor portrait of a woman with a 1960s blonde bob, heavy black eyeliner, wearing a white sleeveless shirt and a bright pink neck scarf. The background should be blurred green and blue foliage.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold red uppercase serif text at the top. Enclose the second line of text in a thin black oval frame. Place a left-aligned list of black sans-serif text on the left side. Add a row of interlocking colored rings at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the red text overlapping the hair?
Is the eyeliner thick and winged?
Is the pill-shaped frame present around the main name?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to keep text legible?

avoid: Clean vector edges on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text is the most vibrant element.
Check that the subject's gaze is directed slightly off-camera.
Verify the presence of the thin black framing line.
Confirm the 1960s period-accurate styling of hair and makeup.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key 60s fashion portrait with bold, red, high-contrast serif typography and a structured list layout to create a retro-pop aesthetic.
